core.title: Cosmopolitan Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull, Laurey COSMO-PC

text.description_html:
Laurey Cosmopolitan Polished Chrome Chrome Cabinet Pull

The Polished Chrome Cosmopolitan Cabinet Pull is available in a few sizes for small and large cabinet doors. The Cosmopolitan Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The sleek design is great for modern kitchen remodels. And it is easy to care for!

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Cosmopolitan Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 5 Sizes:

    LAU-73026:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4" (96mm)
    • Overall Length: 4-1/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73126:
    • C/C Length: 5" (128mm)
    • Total Length: 5-1/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73226:
    • C/C Length: 6-1/4" (160mm)
    • Total Length: 6-1/2"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73326:
    • C/C Length: 7-1/2" (192mm)
    • Total Length: 7-3/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73426:
    • C/C Length: 10" (256mm)
    • Total Length: 10-1/2"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"
